questions.q: What are your plans for the future?
questions.answer: In the short term, I'm focused on strengthening my career and possibly studying abroad. Longer term, I'd like to reach a point where my work has real impact and I have the [[stability]] to enjoy life a little more.

questions.q: Which country would you most like to study in?
questions.answer: Probably the UK or Canada. Both have excellent universities and a strong reputation in business and education. Having helped so many students apply there, I understand the process well, which makes the idea far less [[intimidating]].

questions.q: Where would you like to live in the future?
questions.answer: I'd happily spend a few years abroad for study, but eventually I'd like to settle back in Bangladesh, perhaps in Dhaka or near my hometown. My family is here, and I feel deeply [[rooted]] in this place.

questions.q: Do you usually plan things carefully?
questions.answer: For important matters, definitely. I like to set clear goals and break them into manageable steps. That said, I've learned that life rarely goes exactly to plan, so staying [[adaptable]] is just as important.

questions.q: Do you think your life will be very different in ten years?
questions.answer: I imagine so. Hopefully I'll have completed further studies and be in a more senior position. I might have a family of my own by then too, so my priorities will probably [[evolve]] quite a lot.
